bundlingNotes: Quoted from the document: 'This partial schedule of fees has been prepared and published in compliance with the Insurance Code of the State of California... The rates, fees and charges set forth in this Schedule are on file with the California Department of Insurance and are minimum charges only. Additional rates, fees and charge[s] may be added when unusual risks are assumed or unusual services are performed in accordance with California Insurance Code Section 12401.8.' On the refinance table: 'Standard endorsements are included in the rates set forth above (excludes 110.9/8.1 endorsement). Additional fees may be charged for services such as recording, process service fee, sub-escrow fees, wire transfer fees and overnight delivery charges.' On escrow: 'Additional charges are made for special services, processing fees, associated services rendered in connection with the issuance of any policy, endorsement and/or services performed.' Title insurance premiums are itemized/published in full; the escrow/settlement fee itself is explicitly NOT itemized in this public document and is described as office-location-dependent.

bundlingNotes: Quoted from the document: 'The charges shown in this Guide for escrow services apply to Basic Escrow Services for a residential resale transaction as described in the complete California Schedule of Escrow Fees. Depending on the specific services provided, additional Charges may be made.' Also: 'Pricing herein does not include governmental fees, including recording fees, mortgage registration tax or conservation fee, or fees for other services excluded from the definition of Basic Escrow Services in the California Schedule of Escrow Fees.' And: 'This Guide is not a complete summary or statement of First American's rates and fees. The complete Schedule of Title Insurance Rates and Fees is on file with the California Department of Insurance.' No itemized doc prep/courier/wire/notary/e-recording line items are broken out in this consumer-facing guide — they are implicitly bundled into 'Basic Escrow Services' or fall under the 'additional Charges may be made' catch-all; the only itemized add-ons explicitly priced are the New Loan Services fee and the Short Sale/FSBO surcharge.
transactionContext: Residential resale purchase transactions (all-cash escrow fee table, with a separate published add-on for financed/new-loan transactions) in Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Santa Clara, San Francisco, and San Mateo counties (First American's 'Region 3').
